Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist
• 10%|16%|20% decreased Accuracy Cone Size and Growth
• 15%|24%|30% decreased ADS Animation Duration

source.text:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons, after 1 second of readying the weapon:

+5 | +8 | +10 Aim Assist
0.9x | 0.84x | 0.8x Accuracy Cone Size and Growth
 0.85x | 0.76x | 0.7x ADS Duration Multiplier
